columns.museum_template|usagerecords|usagerecord: Non-null integer value, distinct per row. Likely record registry number for usage record.

columns.museum_template|usagerecords|showcaseref: Twelve-character identifier, letters SC, four digits, six trailing spaces. Unique per row, e.g. SC1006, SC9992. Identifies showcase referenced in usage record.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|sensdatalin: Non-null integer value, distinct per row. Likely link or foreign key to sensitive data record.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|displayrota: Non-null fixed 20-char text. Values Active, Resting, Permanent. Distribution roughly equal. Shows display rotation state.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|displaydurm: Non-null integer months, roughly 1 to 12. Values vary across rows, e.g. 11, 7, 5, 2. Shows how long item displayed.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|restperiodm: Non-null integer months, values from single digits to low 20s. Shows resting period between displays.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|displayreqs: Non-null text 6-8 chars. Values Standard, Special, Custom. Distribution roughly equal. Classifies display requirements.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|storagereqs: Non-null text 6-8 chars. Values Custom, Special, Standard. Distribution roughly equal. Classifies storage needs.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|handlingreq: Non-null text 6-8 chars. Values Custom, Special, Standard. Distribution roughly equal. Classifies handling needs.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|transportre: Non-null text 6-8 chars. Values Standard, Special, Custom. Each occurs 317 times. Classifies transport needs.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|packingreqs: Non-null text 6-8 chars. Values Special, Standard, Custom. Special most common. Classifies packing needs.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|resaccessfr: Non-null fixed 10-char text, right-padded. Values Frequent, Occasional, Rare. Shows how often researchers access item.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|publicdispf: Non-null fixed 25-char text, right-padded. Values Rare, Occasional, Frequent. Shows public display frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|loanfreq: Non-null fixed 12-char text, right-padded. Values Occasional, Frequent, Rare. Shows loan frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|handlefreq: Non-null fixed 10-char text, right-padded. Values Occasional, Rare, Frequent. Shows physical handling frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|docufreq: Non-null text 4-10 chars. Values Occasional, Frequent, Rare. Shows documentation frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|monitorfreq: Non-null text 5-7 chars. Values Daily, Weekly, Monthly. Shows condition monitoring frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|assessfreq: Non-null fixed 25-char text, right-padded. Values Annually, Quarterly, Monthly. Shows assessment frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|maintfreq: Non-null fixed 25-char text, right-padded. Values Monthly, Weekly, Quarterly. Shows maintenance frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|inspectfreq: Non-null fixed 25-char text, right-padded. Values Monthly, Daily, Weekly. Shows inspection frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|calibfreq: Non-null fixed 25-char text, right-padded. Values Annually, Quarterly, Monthly. Shows calibration frequency.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|certstatus: Non-null seven-char text. Values Expired, Current, Pending. Shows certificate state.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|compliances: Non-null text 7-13 chars. Values Partial, Non-compliant, Compliant. Shows compliance state.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|auditstatus: Non-null text 6-7 chars. Values Failed, Passed, Pending. Shows audit result state.
columns.museum_template|usagerecords|qualityctrl: Non-null six-char text. Values Failed, Passed, Review. Shows quality control state.

columns.museum_template|artifactratings|exhibitv: Integer values 1 to 10, roughly evenly distributed. Higher value means greater exhibition worth.

columns.museum_template|artifactratings|publicac: Integer values 1 to 10, roughly evenly distributed. Higher value means greater suitability for public access.
columns.museum_template|artifactratings|eduvalue: Integer values 1 to 10, roughly evenly distributed. Higher value means greater educational value.
columns.museum_template|artifactratings|conserve: Text value: 'Low', 'Medium', or 'High'. Roughly equal counts among 951 records; indicates difficulty of conserving the artifact.
columns.museum_template|artifactratings|treatcom: Fixed 10-character text: 'Simple', 'Moderate', or 'Complex' with trailing spaces. Roughly equal counts; indicates complexity of treatment.

columns.museum_template|artifactratings|deterior: Text value: 'Slow', 'Moderate', or 'Rapid'. Roughly equal counts; indicates rate of artifact deterioration.
